points.name: Return air
points.description: Temperature of air entering the furnace from the return duct.

points.name: Supply air
points.description: Temperature of air leaving the coil into the supply plenum.

points.name: Cooling call (Y)
points.description: Thermostat Y call — the thermostat is asking for cooling.

points.name: Fan call (G)
points.description: Thermostat G call — the thermostat is asking for the blower.

points.name: Compressor amps
points.description: Current on one compressor conductor. Near zero means not running.

points.name: Blower amps
points.description: Current on one blower conductor. Near zero means the fan is off.

points.name: Furnace LED code
points.description: Furnace board LED pattern as a number. Zero means normal.
